title: Reasoning gap: empty-PEM dev behavior for non-moeb projects not explicitly addressed
description: Run 18eadcc3-b142-4096-b3ac-5cbde9dc570c thinking blocks discuss the empty-PEM guard (block 2) and the early-return skip of filesystem write for non-moeb projects (block 3) separately but do not connect them. In dev builds (empty PEM) deployed against a non-moeb client project, moeb-source signals would be silently dropped: not written to filesystem, not sent to GitHub, yet write_file returns 'Signal routed to moeb GitHub Issues.' The assumption that this scenario cannot occur in practice (dev builds only run in the moeb repo itself, where project_id == 'moeb' prevents the early return) was not made explicit in the reasoning.
proposed_resolution: When reasoning about empty-PEM behavior, explicitly connect it to the deployment context assumption: dev builds (empty PEM) are only installed in the moeb repo itself, so the routing condition (project_id != 'moeb') never fires. If client-project dev deployments are ever supported, the return value should distinguish 'routing attempted' from 'routing skipped due to empty PEM'.
